description: A flight search with zero in-budget results must say so plainly and offer to widen the dates or raise the cap — not invent a fare.

blocks.text: Cheapest flight Lisbon to Porto next Friday under 40?

recorded_reply: 0 of the 12 flights I found are under your cap. The cheapest is SKYLINE at €58. Two options: 1) widen to Thursday or Saturday at the same cap; 2) raise the cap to €58. Which do you prefer?
